result.brief: 提出 World Embedding Benchmark，用 8000 个物理仿真视频案例评测视频表征中的物理信息编码，涵盖跨模态对齐与物理属性回归，并展示检索增强可提升生成视频的物理保真度。
result.reason: Benchmark probing how video embeddings encode physical information, with probes on frozen video representations and retrieval-augmented video generation—directly relevant to video representation learning and world models.
